name: Cassava Flour
siboNotes: Cassava flour is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and grain-free, making it easier to digest than wheat-based flours.
preparationTips: Use as 1:1 substitute for wheat flour in most baking recipes
Mix well to avoid clumping - sift before using
Works best when combined with other binding agents like eggs or xanthan gum
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness and prevent moisture absorption
